limitations: Same previously inspected reserved pixels and frozen transforms, not new independent observations or physical ground truth.
Uniform target record strides and phases are deterministic sensitivity controls, not independent validation folds, scanner time or turntable encoder state.
Fixed two-support/three-conflict gates weaken with fewer views; fewer counted conflicts alone is not a better reconstruction.
Frozen common points are fixed by full-list observations; subset common points change population and cannot alone establish improvement.
Support and repeated conflict can overlap. Missing/occluded observations are not counted as free-space errors.
Saved pose optical-axis spread is an estimate under saved registration, not actual camera/turntable metrology.
No candidate, pose, original training gate, source model or fusion output is changed.
